evals.prompt: Create a reusable skill for reviewing Terraform plans safely before apply. It must work in Codex and Claude Code.
evals.expected_output: Creates a focused portable skill with a clear trigger boundary, safe workflow, minimal resources, and representative activation and output evals.
assertions: Activates add-skill.
Resolves the target hosts and safety boundary.
Keeps portable frontmatter limited to supported fields.
Defines direct, negative, incomplete, and edge eval cases.

evals.prompt: This SKILL.md is undertriggering when I ask about pscale slow queries. Improve it without rewriting the whole workflow.
evals.expected_output: Reads the existing skill, makes a minimal description change, and proposes activation cases that distinguish it from generic database questions.
assertions: Activates add-skill.
Preserves unrelated skill content.
Front-loads the recognizable task and tool terms.
Includes at least one plausible non-trigger near miss.

evals.prompt: Fix this skill frontmatter: name: PDF--Helper, description: Helps with files.
evals.expected_output: Normalizes the name, strengthens the description, and explains only the validation failures that matter.
assertions: Activates add-skill.
Uses lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens.
Makes the description state what the skill does and when to use it.
Does not invent unrelated workflow requirements.

evals.prompt: Make me a skill that prepares release notes.
evals.expected_output: Clarifies the installation location or makes an explicit safe default before creating files when the available context does not resolve scope.
assertions: Activates add-skill.
Identifies installation scope as the material missing input.
Asks no more than one focused question when a safe default is unavailable.

evals.prompt: Add a skill selector to this React settings page.
evals.expected_output: Treats skill selector as an application feature rather than authoring a SKILL.md workflow.
assertions: Does not activate add-skill.
Does not create a SKILL.md file.

evals.prompt: Help me improve how my team reviews pull requests.
evals.expected_output: Answers as a process or documentation task unless the user asks to package the workflow as an Agent Skill.
assertions: Does not activate add-skill without a reusable-skill request.
Does not force skill-specific metadata or evals into the answer.

evals.prompt: Create a skill that turns a supplied incident timeline into a concise postmortem outline.
evals.expected_output: Uses an instruction-only skill unless a repeated deterministic transformation or packaged asset is actually required.
assertions: Activates add-skill.
Does not add a script without a reliability or repetition need.
Defines the expected input, output, and missing-evidence behavior.
